description: This file implements the WesterosFocusManager class, which manages focus among surfaces using Wayland protocol in a testing environment. It handles surface creation, destruction, and status updates, and focuses surfaces accordingly.

classes.name: WesterosFocusManager
classes.description: A class that manages surface focus within a Wayland environment for testing purposes, handling surface lifecycle events and focus switching.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes Wayland display connection, registry, and shell, and sets up event listening.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Teardown of resources, disconnecting from Wayland display and cleaning up.

methods.name: onRegistryGlobal
methods.description: Handles new global objects announced by the Wayland registry, binding to the simple shell interface.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Handles surface creation event, adding the surface ID to management and setting focus.

methods.name: onSurfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Handles surface destruction, removing from the list and shifting focus if necessary.

methods.name: onSurfaceStatus
methods.description: Handles surface status updates, adding new surfaces to management.

methods.name: focusSurface
methods.description: Sets focus to a specified surface ID.

methods.name: onWaylandEvent
methods.description: Processes Wayland events when available on the GIOChannel.
